description: A red plastic cup sits on the surface with a toothbrush inside it, and a small tube of toothpaste lies nearby. The right hand reaches forward to lift the toothbrush from the cup while the left hand picks up the toothpaste tube, then the right hand holds the toothbrush steady as the left hand brings the tube’s nozzle over the bristles and squeezes toothpaste onto the brush before pulling the tube away.
